note: An award is named by its own identifier, never by the badge: a member may have several offers of a repeatable badge open.
The signer accepts for themselves only; there is no recipient member.
Hiding is a separate act (vtc/badges/mine/hide); accept carries no display choice.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
